movelist.name: Psychic
movelist.effect: The target is Pushed 1 meter in any direction. Psychic lowers the target’s Special Defense 1 Combat Stage on 17+.

movelist.name: Foul Play
movelist.effect: The target reveals its Attack stat. When calculating damage, add the target’s Attack stat instead of the user’s Attack stat.

movelist.name: Dark Pulse
movelist.effect: Dark Pulse Flinches the target on 17+

movelist.name: Disable
movelist.effect: Disable may be used as a Free Action that does not take up a Command whenever the user is hit by a Move. That Move becomes Disabled for the attacker.

movelist.name: Oblivion Wing
movelist.effect: The user gains Hit Points equal to Oblivion Wing’s Damage Roll.

abilities.name: Type Aura
abilities.effect: The user and all allies within 3 meters gain a +5 Bonus to Damage Rolls with Moves matching the user’s Primary Type.

abilities.name: Pressure
abilities.effect: All foes within 3 meters are Suppressed for 1 full round.

abilities.name: Soulstealer
abilities.trigger: The user’s attack causes a foe to Faint
abilities.effect: The user removes one Injury from themselves and gains Hit Points equal to 25% of their Max Hit Points. If the triggering attack killed its target, the user instead removes all Injuries and recovers Hit Points equal to 50% of the user’s Max Hit Points.
